title: Help paying for food in San Francisco
rule: CalFresh (California's SNAP) puts money for groceries on an EBT card; many working people and students qualify, and immigrants with many visa types or green cards can too. You apply online in about 10 minutes at GetCalFresh.org; Handled cannot submit it for you. Market Match gives you extra money for fruit and vegetables when you pay with CalFresh at participating farmers markets. The SF-Marin Food Bank lists free pantries by neighborhood.
confirm_with: SF Human Services Agency CalFresh (sfhsa.org) or the SF-Marin Food Bank
notes: Income limits change every October and are not computed here; the GetCalFresh screener checks them. Some visas count as public charge questions; ask a free immigration legal service if unsure. Not re-checked today.
